Agent frontmatter moves its house keys under metadata

All 191 G1 violations on src/agents/*.md are gone. Six ork house keys left the top level of all 36 agents and now live under metadata: as quoted strings, and the unread context: key was dropped. The two shared frontmatter parsers lift the house keys back and split the joined lists, so the generated agent docs (agents-data.ts and the reference pages) show zero diff against main.

Why examplePrompts joins on a pipe


frontend-ui-developer has the prompt "Build a data table component with sorting, filtering, and
pagination". A comma join would split it into three prompts and the docs selector would show four. The migration
script refuses any item that already holds its own separator, and the unit test round-trips that exact prompt.
